entries.c28237cfb28982f8: It is a single business that develops, designs, manufactures and sells environmental maintenance equipment, such as high-power suction vehicles, high-pressure washing vehicles, and sludge dewatering and volume reduction machines. Parts for the products are manufactured by outside subcontractors, while the company handles assembly, painting, inspection, sales and after-sales service. After-sales service is provided by branches, sales offices and designated service plants nationwide, and sales for export are mainly made through official development assistance (ODA). Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,097 million.
